who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane of the no-op and std keying for `check --no-daemon`
what: A key task that refuses two items of one stable id can only say a `&'static str` through TaskFailed, so the error the person sees names neither item, file nor line (rule 19). The first end-to-end run on hello-world said 'two items of the unit have one stable id' about `core` with nothing to find them by; the cause (core/src/fmt/num.rs, six `radix_integers!` calls) took reading image.rs to find.
cost: an hour of reading to find which items of core collided
cause: TaskFailed's variants carry static text only (Refused { what: &'static str }); the driver's Failure::Task passes it through
whys: TaskFailed is Copy and crosses the worker pool; an owned message was avoided; nothing typed names an item's place
class: a refusal type that cannot carry the thing it refuses makes every refusal through it unnamed
prevention: not done (blaze-keyed is not this lane's): add `TaskFailed::TwoItems { first: ItemPlace, second: ItemPlace }` with `ItemPlace { file: u32, row: u32 }` (item-relative, rule 71), or a `Refused { what, at: Option<ItemPlace> }`, and print it at file:line from the unit's images
workaround: front::Command keeps the whole line (unit, path, both items at file:line) behind a named lock and the summary prints it under `told` (run::Gathers::told)
